about: The Gradual of the feast of the Most Holy Trinity. It blesses God, who beholds the depths, sits above the Cherubim, and reigns in the firmament of heaven.

seg.tr: Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who beholdest the depths and sittest above the Cherubim,
Blessed art Thou, O Lord, in the firmament of heaven, and worthy of praise for ever.
